authorizedSimulationGearing.method: Nominal tire circumference times60 divided by OEM km/h per1000rpm gives effective overall reductions; divide by arbitrary effective final4 for editor compatibility, NOT physical tooth ratios
authorizedSimulationGearing.caveat: Simulation calibration using geometric unloaded circumference, not measured loaded rolling radius; cannot identify real gear/final split. Reverse not supplied by launch-kit road-speed table. Arbitrary final4 normalization retains speed calibration and keeps bounded editor gear fields valid.
